```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  check-ai-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download check script
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/scripts
          cat > .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/bash

          set -euo pipefail

          # Blocklist of AI agent patterns to detect in git trailers
          AI_COAUTHOR_PATTERNS=(
            "noreply@anthropic.com"
            "noreply@sourcegraph.com"
            "noreply@openai.com"
            "codex@openai.com"
            "aider@aider.chat"
            "gemini@google.com"
            "jules@google.com"
            "@codeium.com"
            "devin-ai-integration\[bot\]"
            "devin@cognition.ai"
            "amazon-q-developer"
            "cline-bot"
            "cline@cline.ai"
            "continue-agent"
            "continue@continue.dev"
            "Claude"
            "Copilot"
            "Cursor"
            "Codex"
            "Gemini"
            "Aider"
            "Devin"
            "Windsurf"
            "Cline"
            "Amazon Q"
            "Jules"
            "OpenCode"
          )

          # Function to check for AI co-authors in commit trailers
          check_ai_coauthors() {
            local commits=()
            if [[ -n "${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-}" ]]; then
              # For PRs, get commits from base to head
              mapfile -t commits < <(git log --pretty=format:"%H" "${GITHUB_BASE_REF}..${GITHUB_HEAD_REF}")
            else
              # For direct pushes, get recent commits
              mapfile -t commits < <(git log --pretty=format:"%H" -10)
            fi

            local found=false
            local error_msg=""

            for commit in "${commits[@]}"; do
              # Get the commit message including trailers
              local commit_msg=$(git show --format="%B" -s "$commit")
              
              # Check for any AI pattern in the commit trailer
              for pattern in "${AI_COAUTHOR_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
                if echo "$commit_msg" | grep -qE "(^|[\r\n])Co-authored-by:.*$pattern"; then
                  error_msg+="Commit $commit contains AI co-author trailer: $(echo \"$commit_msg\" | grep -E \"(^|[\r\n])Co-authored-by:.*$pattern\")\n"
                  found=true
                fi
              done
            done

            if [[ "$found" == true ]]; then
              echo "❌ AI co-authors detected in commits:"
              echo -e "$error_msg"
              echo "💡 Fix: Remove AI co-authors from commits by rebasing and amending commits."
              echo "   Example: git rebase -i HEAD~N && git commit --amend --no-edit"
              exit 1
            fi
          }

          # Run the check
          check_ai_coauthors
          EOF
          chmod +x .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

      - name: Run AI co-author check
        run: .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
```
